result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the promotional banner has a significant contrast problem: white heading and subtext on a pale green background are hard to read. Other elements (carousels, bottom-cut card) are expected behaviors and not reported.

issues.description: In the '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner, the white heading and the 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' subtext sit on a light mint-green background, resulting in very low color contrast and poor readability.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker green background or dark-colored text on the light background to meet WCAG contrast ratios (at least 4.5:1 for body text).

issues.description: The rightmost category filter chip is cut off at the screen edge with no visual affordance (e.g., fade or scroll hint) indicating the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle gradient fade or partial-chip peek with consistent spacing to signal horizontal scrollability.
